$Comment: What the Horseman's Hoard (Rewards/Hallows_Eve/Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase) pays. Every roll is
read on its own: the first has no Chance, so it always pays and the Hoard is never empty; the
four after it are the chances at the Flaming Hallowed set's pieces (the Burning Jack Helm, the
Horseman's flaming gauntlets and greaves, and the Flaming Jack Shield); the last two are pieces of
his graveyard to build with, a tombstone and a ruins lantern like the ones that stand in it,
which no recipe makes. His flaming breastplate is not here: it pays only from his Hoard on the
hard ride (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase_Hard.json), which also rolls these pieces at better odds.
His plain armour pays from his daily Claim (Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Daily.json). The Almanac's
Hoard grid (ZiggfreedCommon/Almanac/HallowsEvePack/Hallows_Eve.json) lists what this table and
the hard one pay, so change them together. Chance is a percent from 0 to 100.
Name: Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Chase
